description: ACCDB: Parameterized ADODB.Command.Execute: Parameters.Append across adInteger(3), adVarWChar(202), adDouble(5), adDate(7), adCurrency(6), adBoolean(11), adNumeric(131), and Null for INSERT, SELECT, UPDATE (with RecordsAffected ByRef & re-execution with mutated Parameter.Value), scalar Parameters argument in Execute(ra, val, opts), and error mapping (missing param, type mismatch, dup PK). Keeps all pages.

args.text: CREATE TABLE ParamT (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_ParamT PRIMARY KEY, S TEXT(30), D DOUBLE, DT DATETIME, C CURRENCY, Y BIT, DC DECIMAL(18,4))
INSERT INTO ParamT (ID, S, D, DT, C, Y, DC) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
SELECT ID, S, D, C, Y, DC FROM ParamT WHERE ID = ?
UPDATE ParamT SET S = ?, D = ? WHERE ID = ?
SELECT ID, S, D, DT, C, Y, DC FROM ParamT ORDER BY ID
